# Colour emoji images: Twemoji's 72px PNGs, downloaded once at configure time into the gitignored assets/emoji.
# A failed download only warns; the build then ships no images and emoji draw a fallback glyph.
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION 17.0.3)
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256 d8a269885d95c78123cc0981c8c76a4c55466cdcb6c7c939434323533e6cd754)
set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL "https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/archive/refs/tags/v${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}.zip")

function(vitadeck_fetch_twemoji)
  set(dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/emoji")
  set(stamp "${dir}/.twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
  set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND OFF PARENT_SCOPE)
  if(EXISTS "${stamp}")
    set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
    return()
  endif()
  if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.18)
    message(WARNING "Twemoji needs CMake 3.18 to extract; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
    return()
  endif()

  set(staging "${dir}/.download")
  set(archive "${staging}/twemoji.zip")
  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
  message(STATUS "Downloading Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}")
  file(DOWNLOAD "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}" "${archive}" STATUS status INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT 60 TLS_VERIFY ON)
  list(GET status 0 code)
  set(problem "")
  if(NOT code EQUAL 0)
    list(GET status 1 problem)
  else()
    file(SHA256 "${archive}" hash)
    if(NOT hash STREQUAL VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256)
      set(problem "SHA-256 is ${hash}, expected ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_SHA256}")
    endif()
  endif()
  if(problem)
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
    message(WARNING "Twemoji download from ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL} failed: ${problem}. "
                    "The build has no emoji images, so emoji draw a fallback glyph. Reconfigure to retry.")
    return()
  endif()

  set(images_dir "twemoji-${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}/assets/72x72")
  file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${staging}" PATTERNS "${images_dir}/*.png")
  file(GLOB previous "${dir}/*.png" "${dir}/.twemoji-*")
  if(previous)
    file(REMOVE ${previous})
  endif()
  file(GLOB images "${staging}/${images_dir}/*.png")
  foreach(image IN LISTS images)
    get_filename_component(name "${image}" NAME)
    # The emoji loader names images with U+FE0F left out.
    string(REPLACE "-fe0f" "" name "${name}")
    file(RENAME "${image}" "${dir}/${name}")
  endforeach()
  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
  list(LENGTH images count)
  if(count EQUAL 0)
    message(WARNING "Twemoji archive has no ${images_dir}/*.png; emoji draw a fallback glyph.")
    return()
  endif()
  file(WRITE "${stamp}" "${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_URL}\n")
  message(STATUS "Twemoji ${VITADECK_TWEMOJI_VERSION}: ${count} images in assets/emoji")
  set(VITADECK_TWEMOJI_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

vitadeck_fetch_twemoji()
